map.频率分辨率（Δf = f_s / N） 使用指南: Frequency resolution (delta f = f_s / N) - user guide
map.输入采样率与 FFT 点数 N，按 Δf = fs / N 计算频率分辨率，用于: Enter sampling rate and FFT point count N; compute frequency resolution by delta f = fs / N, for judging the minimum resolvable frequency interval and window length in spectrum analysis.
map.N 点 FFT 的频率分辨率为采样率除以点数。: The frequency resolution of an N-point FFT is sampling rate divided by N.
map.采样率 fs 与点数 N 决定频率分辨率 df = fs/N。: Sampling rate fs and point count N determine frequency resolution df = fs / N.
map.区分相近频率分量所需的点数测算。: Number of points needed to distinguish close frequency components.
map.加窗前评估频谱泄漏与分辨率。: Assess spectral leakage and resolution before windowing.
map.：分辨率 df = 1000 / 1024 ≈ 0.977 Hz，即相邻谱线间隔: : resolution df = 1000 / 1024 approx 0.977 Hz, i.e. adjacent spectral lines about 1 Hz apart.
map.：若 N 增到 8192，则 df ≈ 0.122 Hz，能分辨更接近的频率。: : if N increases to 8192, then df approx 0.122 Hz, able to resolve closer frequencies.
map.由相位差与角频率差求群时延: Find group delay from phase difference and angular-frequency difference
map.增大 N（更长的采集时间）或降低 fs，df = fs/N。: Increase N (longer acquisition time) or lower fs; df = fs/N.
map.分辨率与泄漏是一回事吗？: Are resolution and leakage the same thing?
map.不是，分辨率是谱线间隔，泄漏由截断窗引起，二者需分别处理。: No, resolution is the spectral line spacing, leakage is from the truncation window; the two need separate handling.
